answer: Signal-bounty bond: each identity locks 70 credits and posts a signal offering its bond to anyone who proves it fake. A hunter files a comet claim proving a duplicate key or rented history; a prism auditor splits it into facets — key, work, graph — replays each on the ledger; a failed facet burns the bond and pays the hunter. Filing costs 40, then 40+6(k-1) per k-th; 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once.
